code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated RDW, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or systemic inflammation. Elevated creatinine indicates impaired renal function. High ferritin, D-dimer, and CRP suggest significant inflammation and possible acute phase response. Mildly elevated monocytes, basophils, and chloride are noted. Liver enzymes are mostly normal, but CK and AST are low. Findings are consistent with acute systemic illness, possibly infection or inflammatory process, with risk for hypoxia and renal involvement; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
